checks.message: BCV: 1 months dropped (last observation more than 5 days before month-end): 2026-11
10:1 split of May 2020 present in the data (2020-05-28). Splits: 2020-05-28 (×10).
No daily change > 35% in the adjusted price (max |r| = 14.6%, on 2009-03-10).
Dividend adjustment: 23 ex-dividend dates; total return − price return = +3.39% per year on average.
Fund: published TER 1.11% as of 2026-03-31.
Fund: 1 months dropped (last observation more than 5 days before month-end): 2026-11

Fund: 100.00% of the 7323 daily returns of the official series reproduced from NAVs and gross distributions (tolerance 5e-05); tooltip NAVs lag by one day from about 2021-09-28, lag corrected in the check.
Fund: the 28 published distributions are included exactly once, at the gross amount (latest: 2026-07-21, 5.70 CHF).
Fund: recomputed YTD performance 15.56% vs 15.56% published by Gérifonds as of 2026-11-05.
Raiffeisen fund: 1 months dropped (last observation more than 5 days before month-end): 2026-11
Raiffeisen fund: "Chart Price" equal to the published NAV.
Raiffeisen fund: outside distributions, total return = NAV return on 100.00% of 4260 days.
Raiffeisen fund: published TER 1.20% as of 2026-06-30.

SPI: history data/history/spi_tr_history.csv spliced onto ^SSHI after a consistency check — 3061 common trading days (2013-03-05 → 2025-05-16); median ratio 1.00000, drift +0.000%, diverging days 0.03%
SPI: 1 months dropped (last observation more than 5 days before month-end): 2026-11
SPI total-return plausibility: mean return SPI − SMI (price index) = +2.09% per year over 431 months. Indicative only (different constituents); the TR nature rests on SIX's definition of the SPI.
Daily SARON available from 2009-08-24 to 2026-10-30; monthly return = ACT/360 compounding.
Consistency of Mkt−RF and RF between the FF3 and FF5 files: max differences 0.00e+00 and 0.00e+00.
Swiss JKP factors from 1993-07 to 2025-12 (months kept: at least 30 stocks per factor), converted to CHF as F_USD(1+s). Updated annually: the latest months of the sample may be missing.
Correlation of Swiss JKP / European Fama-French factors (USD): SMB 0.58, HML 0.64, RMW 0.40, CMA 0.34, MOM 0.78. Moderate correlations expected: different markets and methods.
European Fama-French factors converted to CHF: market = (1+Mkt−RF+RF_US)(1+s)−1, long-short factors = F_USD(1+s). The market excess return is computed with SARON, never with the US RF.

notes: Missing values kept as they are (null): no interpolation.
